answer: Unrepeatable challenge ledger. Each new identity must answer a fresh, randomly derived puzzle whose solution is a unique string bound to its submission time, so copying a prior answer fails validation. An attacker can wander across many fake accounts, but manufacturing a valid solution for each costs one full compute round, making mass registration linearly expensive. Honest users pay once and store their answer in a local dune of cached proofs, while the system keeps a public oasis of verified but non-reusable responses to check duplicates.
